fix:
<reasoning>
The 17 compile errors all share one root cause: the WMMA API from `<mma.h>` lives in the `nvcuda::wmma` namespace, but the code only does `using namespace cute;`. Every `wmma::fragment`, `wmma::load_matrix_sync`, `wmma::mma_sync`, etc. fails to resolve, producing "name followed by `::` must be a class or namespace name" cascading errors. The fix is a single line: `using namespace nvcuda;`.

While fixing, I also address the latent correctness bug the compile error was masking: the kernel performs only one 16×16×16 `mma_sync` over `k = 0..15`, silently dropping reduction elements `k = 16..26` (11 of the 27 real K terms). The K tile is 32 (27 real + 5 zero-padded), so a loop over both K sub-tiles is required to complete the contraction `C[m,n] += A[m,k] * B[k,n]`. This preserves the tiled/WMMA structure and the custom kernel design — it simply completes the intended algorithm. The A operand (MxK col-major, ldm=kGemmM) advances by `k_step * kGemmM` elements per K sub-tile; the B operand (KxN col-major, ldm=kGemmK) advances by `k_step` rows. The zero-padding in the smem loaders makes the second step safe. No intent changes: same custom WMMA/CUTE-style kernel, same launch structure, same precision, no library fallbacks.

Edit 1: insert `using namespace nvcuda;` before line 20 (right after `using namespace cute;` on line 19).
Edit 2: replace lines 104–114 with the accumulator declaration, fill, K-step loop, and store.
</reasoning>

      "  wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, kWarpTile, kWarpTile, kWarpTile, float> c_frag;",
      "  wmma::fill_fragment(c_frag, 0.0f);",
      "  // K tile is 32 (27 real + 5 zero-padded), so two 16x16x16 steps cover it.",
      "  for (int k_step = 0; k_step < kGemmK; k_step += kWarpTile) {",
      "    wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, kWarpTile, kWarpTile, kWarpTile,",
      "                   __nv_bfloat16, wmma::col_major> a_frag;",
      "    wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, kWarpTile, kWarpTile, kWarpTile,",
      "                   __nv_bfloat16, wmma::col_major> b_frag;",
      "    // A is MxK col-major (ldm = kGemmM): one K sub-tile = kGemmM elements.",
      "    wmma::load_matrix_sync(a_frag, smem_a + k_step * kGemmM + warp_m, kGemmM);",
      "    // B is KxN col-major (ldm = kGemmK): one K sub-tile = kWarpTile rows.",
      "    wmma::load_matrix_sync(b_frag, smem_b + warp_n * kGemmK + k_step, kGemmK);",
      "    wmma::mma_sync(c_frag, a_frag, b_frag, c_frag);",
      "  }",
      "  wmma::store_matrix_sync(smem_c + warp_m * kGemmN + warp_n,",
      "                          c_frag, kGemmN, wmma::mem_row_major);"
    ]
  }
